requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-4875-5291--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Conspiracy, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Cursed Mirror. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Conspiracy, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

3967-7084-8232.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Alharu trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Alharu trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

1879-3755-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2595-6495--5.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-6495--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing your creatures that enter this turn to enter with a +1/+1 counter on them.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2
2595-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Rowan, Scholar of Sparks // Will, Scholar of Frost

618-4456-7494-7644.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Rowan or Will.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1362-1479-6662.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack, Kodama of the East Tree, and any Bird tokens created by Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Chocbo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack and any Bird tokens created by it trigger.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all Bird triggers, giving each Bird token +1/+0 until end of turn for each land that entered while that Bird was on the battlefield.

500-1777-3191-5361.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Auton Soldier and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Auton Soldier dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Auton Soldier tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Burnt Offering, adding {B}{B}{B/R}{B/R}{B/R}{B/R}
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-1777-3191-5361.notes: You can forego casting Burnt Offering if you have enough black mana. This'll allow you to net creature tokens. The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

1734-2034-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3719-5326-7193.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Omni-Changeling and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Omni-Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Omni-Changeling to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Omni-Changeling enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Omni-Changeling by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1506-7124.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
1506-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate The Incredible Hulk by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to it.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-2842-5670--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
628-2842-5670--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, and its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter on it. Blood Artist also triggers regardless.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat

1086-2034-3490-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-2034-3490-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with eight or more +1/+1 counters on it
attached to any creature you control except Sekki

1475-1724-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sekki
When Sekki dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating at least eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1492-1879.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-1879.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

67-2781-3967.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

413-2267-5058.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

457-4927-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-4927-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

224-3886-6628.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {3}.
224-3886-6628.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Soratami Mirror Mage by paying {3} and returning the three lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Soratami Mirror-Mage abilities, returning any number of creatures from the battlefield to their owners' hands.
224-3886-6628.notes: You can repeat this loop as desired to constantly return creatures to their owner's hands as they enter the battlefield.

856-2981-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2457-4068-4289-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2457-4068-4289-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2793-5315-5483.description:
During your end step, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Esoteric Duplicator triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus at the beginning of your next end step.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Esoteric Duplicator triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Repeat.

2092-3007-4131.notablePrerequisites:
Toymaker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
2092-3007-4131.description:
Activate Toymaker by paying {1}, tapping it and discarding a card, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-413-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Entering.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-413-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

165-499-2034-2948-3560.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one experience counter.
165-499-2034-2948-3560.description:
Activate Daxos by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit enchantment creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus and Spirit, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Farrelite Priest by paying {1}, adding {W}.
Activate Initiates of the Ebon Hand by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1636-2034-2083-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C}.
Wood Sage does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2034-2083-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature on top of your library.
Activate Wood Sage by tapping it, naming the creature put on top of your library, then revealing the top four cards of your library and putting the creature into your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

67-2517-5147-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
67-2517-5147-5276.description:
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 4, returning Reveillark from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2724-3987-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
2034-2724-3987-5131.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {C}{C}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger when it enters the battlefield due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

275-1799-3621-5256.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of eight or greater.
275-1799-3621-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi Cave Guard's power.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1263-2178-2292-2661.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Gwenna.
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has attacked this turn.
1263-2178-2292-2661.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
Bloodsoaked Champion dies, triggering Gwenna, untapping Gwenna.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

308-688-2425-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
308-688-2425-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Haunted Dead, adding {B}.
Smothering Abomination triggers, drawing you a card.
Activate Haunted Dead by paying {B} and discarding two cards, returning Haunted Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Haunted Dead enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Smothering Abomination triggers, drawing you a card.
Repeat.
